notes.about: Robot-to-web fall incident event contract. The robot journal writes these values and the web accepts only these. Change this file, then run `node scripts/sync-fall-contract.mjs` in malbut_web; CI fails while the web copy differs.
notes.eventKinds: approach_*/person_check_completed: the robot drives near an uncertain suspicion and checks for a person first. view_completed/posture_check_completed: only part of the body seen, it moves to see the whole body, then checks the posture. check_waiting/check_not_confirmed/revisit_started/same_person_compared: could not ask yet (manual drive or another job), a minute of that, going back to the spot before asking, and comparing the person with the first scene (mockup 28). check_stopped: 'stop' during the check, stopped without a question (2026-10-13).
notes.reasonsByKind: Allowed reasons per event kind; null means no reason (only an approach start that interrupted nothing). Kinds not listed accept any reason matching ^[a-z_]{1,80}$. person_check_completed nobody_there: went back after waiting and found no one, not a closure. posture_check_completed: off the floor only when the robot's measurement and Cloud agree, anything else asks; active_on_floor is sitting up busy on the floor, seen twice, no fall seen (2026-10-14). same_person_compared: clothing only, for reference, never changes what the robot does.
notes.resolvedReasons: A robot-side closure after its own check, never a normal-activity judgment. guardian_closed: a member pressed 처리 완료 and the robot stopped trying.
notes.notificationReasons: Reason -> notification level. Web-only reasons are never accepted from a robot. Per-reason ones are sent once per reason per incident, outside the 'only a higher level' rule.
